# Mechanics Lab coverage

PHASE_06 §6.5. The implementation-facing ledger for the Mechanics Lab corpus in
`Test Deck/Testing Deck/`: what each card is there to test (from the CSV), and what
Proxic has actually done with it (from `mechanics-lab-status.json`).

> **Passing P6-AS does not mean all mechanics in the corpus are supported.** It proves
> the corpus is read as written, every card resolves to the printing asked for, Forge
> builds it, its art maps, and a real game starts with it. Whether any one card PLAYS
> correctly is the per-card result below, and most of those are not yet tested.

## The whole corpus (Layer A, P6-AS)

- **275 entries, 390 cards**, 14 of them multiface.
- **Forge resolves all of them** to the printing the TXT names, against the pinned Forge
  (4ec5f1a2). None refused. `MechanicsLabCorpusTest`, which pins that list.
- **Forge builds a deck** from the corpus and **a real game starts** with it as both
  libraries. `MechanicsLabCorpusTest`.
- **Every one of the 275 images** passes the importer's validation, every entry finds its
  image, and every card finds its art at MATCH time too. `MechanicsLabArtTest` (local only:
  the images are never committed, AGENTS GIT-001).
- **The upload route refuses it**, correctly: 390 cards is not Open Format (60-65, §2.45)
  and its 289 MB of art exceeds the 150 MB package limit. Each import stage is run on its
  own instead; the refusal itself is asserted.
- **The TXT and CSV are unchanged** (§6.4): their SHA-256s are pinned in
  `MechanicsLabCorpusTest`.
